Forman theory and the classification of maps S^7->S^7 then prove M(Z/2,7), not only homology.

value.rationale: The Chvátal graph is the smallest regular triangle-free four-chromatic graph, a canonical boundary object. Its pure eight-dimensional three-cut complex has an exact Moore-space homotopy type and integral two-torsion, obstructing shellability and demonstrating substantive topology beyond the torsion-free and sphere-wedge theorems restricted by short-cycle hypotheses. The degree-two attachment, not the face count alone, supplies its structural content.
